chunks: Yet God may turn (even) after this to whomsoever He please, for God is compassionate and kind.

key_terms.ذَٰلِكَ: That / this (referring to the preceding context)

ai.seo_question: When does God accept repentance after a delay?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific case of the Banu Murrah tribe or the general principle of divine discretion (Ikhtiyar) in forgiveness, underscoring that God's mercy is not bound by human timelines. It highlights the balance between divine justice and the boundless attribute of Rahmah (Mercy), affirming that repentance remains valid until the soul reaches the throat. This reinforces the Shia belief in the accessibility of divine grace for those who sincerely turn back, regardless of prior transgressions.
